environment.description: Identical Celery worker deployment on ECS Fargate. The worker's task role (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/celery-worker-staging) has ses:SendRawEmail. However, the AWS Organization applies SCP 'EnforceSESv2ConfigurationSet' (p-stagingses01) which contains a Deny statement on ses:SendRawEmail UNLESS the condition key 'ses:FromAddress' matches the verified identity AND 'aws:RequestedRegion' equals 'us-east-1'. Additionally, the IAM role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:policy/WorkerPermBoundary) that includes an explicit Deny on ses:SendRawEmail when StringNotEquals condition on 'ses:Recipients' fails to match the pattern '*@example.com'. The permission boundary also denies ses:SendRawEmail if the 'ses:FeedbackAddress' header is present in the request context, which SES evaluates from the raw message headers - any injected BCC/CC/additional recipient headers that resolve to non-@example.com domains are rejected at the IAM evaluation layer before SES processes the message.

config.ses_config: SES in sandbox mode with configuration set requiring verified recipients
config.network: Private subnet, outbound SMTP (587) allowed only to SES VPC endpoint
